evals.prompt: Design the booking flow for a small clinic's web app. Patients book, move, and cancel appointments with a clinician at a location. Receptionists manage the same appointments all day.
evals.expected_output: An object map comes before any layout and drives the routes. Occasional patients and frequent receptionists are treated differently, with a decision record and a validation status that names what was not tested.
expectations: Object map covers Patient, Appointment, Clinician, and Location before layout
Patients get a clear sequence with review and confirmation
Receptionists get an efficient list for all-day management. Filtering is not required by the brief; if a design adds filtering, a selected item stays visible under that filter
Accessibility target of WCAG 2.2 AA is stated, with tested and untested items listed

evals.prompt: Design an expressive mobile architecture journal with essays, author profiles and photography. Retain existing serif typography and monochrome palette. No accounts or transactions.
evals.expected_output: Editorial hierarchy and meaningful photography, preserving the existing visual direction, with reading and discovery criteria and no invented dashboard or accounts.
expectations: Preserves the existing serif and monochrome direction
Editorial hierarchy and purposeful photography
Object map produced or skipped with a reason before structure
Reading and discovery acceptance criteria
No invented dashboard, accounts, or transactions

evals.prompt: Specify a shop product page for custom desks. Existing brand system. Buyers compare dimensions and materials; shipping cost is known only after postcode. No fabricated reviews or delivery promises.
evals.expected_output: Supports an informed choice and shows total-cost uncertainty honestly, within the existing brand system and without invented guarantees.
expectations: Handles unknown shipping cost until a postcode is given
Retains the brand system
No fabricated reviews or delivery promises
Responsive comparison of dimensions and materials

evals.prompt: Specify an expert diagram editor with keyboard, canvas objects, undo and save status. Desktop editing; mobile viewing only. No AI/collaboration.
evals.expected_output: Gives creative control with keyboard alternatives, preserves edits, reports save status truthfully, and respects the stated desktop and mobile scope.
expectations: Keyboard alternatives for canvas manipulation
Undo and truthful save status
Does not add AI or collaboration
Mobile is view-only as stated

evals.prompt: Redesign a Material order queue for expert tablet operators. Filters can hide the selected order. Keep its identity and actions available. No offline sending.
evals.expected_output: Borrows data patterns without switching to a Carbon appearance, keeps the selected order and its actions visible, and respects connectivity limits.
expectations: Keeps the Material appearance while borrowing data patterns
The selected order and its actions stay visible when a filter hides it from the list
Does not add offline sending
Recovery states and validation evidence are stated

evals.prompt: Change only the wording of an existing confirmation button; layout, behaviour and relationships stay unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Skips the object map with a one-line reason, retains the existing system, and does not produce a large specification.
expectations: Records Map: skipped with a reason
Does not produce a large specification
Retains the existing system

evals.prompt: Specify a report editor that streams AI proposals while users edit. Regeneration must preserve edits. Email sending needs explicit authorisation; no numerical confidence provided.
evals.expected_output: Applies the AI checks: edit and regeneration conflicts are visible, proposal and execution are separate, and no confidence or success is invented.
expectations: AI checks applied because the feature is AI-enabled
Regeneration never overwrites user edits and conflicts are visible
Drafting is separate from sending, and sending needs explicit authorisation
No fake confidence figures or premature success states

evals.prompt: Build a SwiftUI settings screen for a notes app with a floating toolbar. Make it feel current.
evals.expected_output: Chooses Apple HIG and suitable SwiftUI controls for the supported OS and SDK. Glass is optional, not required. When translucency is used, reduced transparency and increased contrast have an opaque fallback.
expectations: Selects Apple HIG and suitable SwiftUI controls, not Material
Does not require glass or other newer materials
Checks the supported OS and SDK before adopting a newer material
When translucency is used, reduced transparency and increased contrast have an opaque fallback

evals.prompt: Make a personal portfolio homepage for a freelance photographer.
evals.expected_output: Treats the page as communication and evaluation, not a dashboard, with a stated visual direction and a clear contact route.
expectations: Does not invent an operational dashboard
Object map is produced, reused, or skipped according to whether relationships affect the homepage structure, with a reason
Focus on visitor questions and a contact route
No compliance or research claims

evals.prompt: Design a logo for my bakery.
evals.expected_output: Grader only. Standalone logo generation is out of scope, so the method should not run. The performing agent is given only the prompt, with no instruction to use the method.
expectations: Does not run the object-map gate or produce a decision record

evals.prompt: Specify a landing page for farm-work SaaS. Retain its established violet and cream brand. Field staff record daily work on Android phones; managers use those entries in weekly reports. Offline entry is not supported. Real product screenshots are available; no ROI data is supplied.
evals.expected_output: Task-first communication connects field entry to reporting, preserves the brand and exposes connectivity limits without invented proof.
expectations: Makes audience and connected workflow readily understandable, using real product evidence
Retains violet and cream rather than prescribing agricultural green
Does not invent offline support, ROI or testimonials
Applies the object-map gate according to structural relevance before layout
Proposes comprehension or findability checks without claiming measured outcomes

evals.prompt: Design a content-heavy landing page introducing an independent history journal. Retain its serif typography and monochrome identity. Visitors read long essays and browse themed collections. No accounts, sales or mailing list. Some introductions need several paragraphs to explain their context.
evals.expected_output: Supports reading and discovery with progressive depth and the existing identity, without arbitrary conversion requirements.
expectations: Preserves serif and monochrome identity and meaningful contextual content
Does not impose a CTA, signup, headline word quota or fixed section count
Uses hierarchy and deeper routes fitted to reading and discovery
Defines comprehension or discovery checks with honest evidence levels

evals.prompt: Review the information hierarchy of a private physiotherapy service landing page. Existing branding stays. The supplied brief says visits cost 80 pounds, referral is required, this is not an emergency service, and cancellation within 24 hours incurs the full fee. Booking happens on an external provider. Suggest a hierarchy; do not invent clinical claims.
evals.expected_output: Keeps consequential service conditions at the booking decision and makes the external handoff clear, with proportionate review findings.
expectations: Keeps price, referral requirement, emergency limitation and cancellation fee accessible at the decision point
Does not hide critical conditions in optional supporting detail
Explains the external booking handoff without inventing provider behaviour or clinical outcomes
Uses keep/change/defer review labels and distinguishes proposed checks from actual observations

evals.prompt: Plan a B2B software site for practitioners and procurement reviewers. Practitioners explore workflows; procurement compares plans, supported integrations and security limitations. Products belong to multiple plans, and visitors can reach a product from either audience route. Navigation is being redesigned. Retain the existing design system; missing pricing and integration details must remain unknown.
evals.expected_output: Maps the relationships before navigation and supports distinct audience questions without inventing commercial or technical facts.
expectations: Produces or reuses a verified map of products, plans and relevant relationships before routes or layout
Supports both audience journeys and shared product destinations
Retains the existing system and uses comparable information for evaluation
Marks unknown prices, integrations and security facts rather than inventing them

evals.prompt: Change only this farm-software hero headline: 'The future of farming is here.' The verified offer is daily work logging and weekly reporting. Keep the current audience, violet brand, layout, links and behaviour. Give a clearer headline; no page redesign.
evals.expected_output: Delivers a focused truthful headline revision and skips structural work with a brief reason.
expectations: Supplies clear copy grounded in daily logging and weekly reporting
Records Map: skipped with a reason tied to unchanged structure
Preserves layout, links, behaviour and brand
Avoids a full-page specification, forced CTA or invented capabilities

evals.prompt: Review a banking product landing page that uses an established accessible terracotta and cream brand. The brief explicitly retains that identity. Improve semantic action and feedback colour roles and information hierarchy. No new brand palette, unverified financial claims or conversion results are wanted.
evals.expected_output: Works within the existing identity and defines semantic distinctions without industry colour stereotypes or false validation claims.
expectations: Retains terracotta and cream rather than switching banking to blue
Distinguishes semantic action, status and feedback roles with colour-independent meaning
Proposes applicable contrast checks without claiming new states were already tested
Does not invent financial benefits, research or conversion improvements

evals.prompt: Specify a landing page for an AI scheduling companion. It proposes meeting times and drafts invitations; sending requires explicit user approval. Suggestions can be wrong. Only a labelled concept illustration is available, with no real screenshots, testimonials, accuracy figures or retention data. Keep those evidence limits visible.
evals.expected_output: Communicates proposal versus execution and uncertainty using honest concept media and proportionate AI guidance.
expectations: Separates proposed times and draft invitations from sending with explicit approval
Communicates uncertainty and relevant limitations without numerical confidence invention
Labels concept imagery and does not present it as real product proof
Does not fabricate screenshots, testimonials, accuracy or retention results
Defines comprehension and informed-action checks without claiming actual user outcomes
